maddeler.e:
أنغرز (form VII)
# أَنْغَرِزُ (ʔanḡarizu) /ʔan.ɣa.ri.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# أَنْغَرِزَ (ʔanḡariza) /ʔan.ɣa.ri.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# أَنْغَرِزْ (ʔanḡariz) /ʔan.ɣa.riz/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
